system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> updated app recently on android and when using bluetooth it disconnects after a couple of songs. Thought it was my BT speaker but happens in my car too. Any ideas?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Can you share the device, operating system, and Spotify version you're using? We'll see what we can suggest! Let us know how it goes."
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Request more details and suggest basic troubleshooting steps for clarity and helpfulness."}
